title: Single vehicle delivers ten jobs minimizing distance
description: Baseline positive with travel_cost=distance and mode=car; all deliveries fit within capacity.
expectedResult: 200; status:'Ok' with id; result.code==0; all 10 jobs assigned; result.summary.unassigned==0; result.unassigned empty; route delivery load <= capacity [100].

title: Single vehicle completes ten pickup jobs within capacity
description: jobs.pickup coverage: picked-up load accrues to route end and stays within capacity.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; all 10 jobs assigned; result.unassigned empty; cumulative pickup load <= capacity [100].

title: A shipment pickup precedes its delivery on the same vehicle
description: shipments coverage: one pickup->delivery pair plus deliveries; pickup sequenced before delivery.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; the shipment pickup step index < its delivery step index on the same vehicle; all tasks assigned; result.unassigned empty.

title: allow_early_arrival=true produces a feasible plan
description: options.objective.allow_early_arrival coverage: with early arrival allowed the plan solves fully.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; all 10 jobs assigned; result.unassigned empty; solver honors allow_early_arrival=true.

title: sequence_order_penalty accepted; plan solves fully
description: options.constraint.sequence_order_penalty coverage: a soft penalty is accepted and all jobs assigned.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; all 10 jobs assigned; result.unassigned empty; sequence_order_penalty accepted.

title: Reject request missing required vehicles
description: Malformed: vehicles omitted -> rejected at submit.
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); message names missing vehicles; no usable id.

title: Reject out-of-range location_index
description: A job references an index beyond locations.location.
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); message indicates location_index out of range; no id.

title: Reject out-of-range coordinate string
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); message identifies the out-of-range coordinate; no id.

title: Over-capacity delivery leaves tasks unassigned
description: Infeasible-but-valid: total delivery demand exceeds capacity -> some jobs in result.unassigned (not an error).
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; at least one job in result.unassigned with a capacity reason; assigned delivery load <= capacity [20].

title: Reject travel_cost outside the allowed enum
description: options.objective.travel_cost set to an unsupported value.
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); travel_cost 'fastest' not an allowed value; no id.

title: Reject shipment with pickup but no delivery
description: A shipment object omits the required delivery step.
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); shipment requires both pickup and delivery; no id.

title: Submit returns id; result retrievable by id
description: Verify the async contract end to end.
expectedResult: 200; submit status:'Ok' with non-empty id; GET /result?id=ID returns result.code==0.

title: Result body conforms to the optimization schema
description: Verify result has summary, routes, unassigned.
expectedResult: 200; result.code==0; Content-Type application/json; result has summary, routes, unassigned; passes schema validation.

title: Reject result fetch missing id
expectedResult: 400 (input validation failed); id required; no partial result.
